findings.message: Goal / Why says the successor `phase3-continue-02` 'embeds `tests/test_seeded_phase3_01.py` as its idiom'. This ticket creates that file on its code branch. The seed lifts to main through the ticket-plane lane at this ticket's Check, before the branch merges, so the seed's `## Context` names a path missing from main. Section 13 requires every Context path to already exist. 19.L requires each continuation to embed 'one merged earlier seeding test as its idiom, never the test created in its own admission'. Commit 7130ee8 repaired the same defect in phase3-continue itself, whose Context had named the unmerged tests/test_seeded_phase3_core.py.
